item.title: [PARQUET-1544] Possible over-shading of modules
item.description:

At first it's not immediately obvious if this is a problem in Iceberg's dependency chain, or if it's a problem in how parquet-avro is packaged. But I'm filing here because it appears linked to PARQUET-1529, where we shaded FastUtil in various modules, including parquet-avro. A hypothesis is that applying the shading plugin caused references to Jackson 1 to be shaded as well, and that libraries that depend on both parquet-avro and Avro itself (as Iceberg does) are at risk of having mismatching implementations being loaded on the classpath.

status.description: A resolution has been taken, and it is awaiting verification by reporter. From here issues are either reopened, or are closed.

comments.comment: For an example of the failure, see this build. which was in an attempt to upgrade Parquet in Iceberg. I wonder if we weren't supposed to shade Jackson as well, but applying the maven shade plugin inadvertently caused that to happen?

I confirmed this isn't specific to Palantir's fork of Spark and would apply if we took Parquet's master branch as a dependency directly:

  1. Checkout upstream master
  2. mvn install
  3. Make Iceberg depend on parquet 1.12.0-SNAPSHOT from the local Maven repository
  4. ./gradlew test fails with the same error.
